name: Left Shoe (Only Left)
description: Right wala alag se bikta hai... par available nahi hai. Kabhi nahi hoga.

name: Premium Air (1 Litre, Sealed)
description: Shimla ki hawa, dabba mein band. Price badhti ja rahi hai jaise jaise aap yeh padh rahe hain... ab aur badh gayi... abhi bhi padh rahe ho? AUR BADH GAYI.

name: Used WiFi (500 MB, Slightly Damp)
description: Pehle se download kiya hua WiFi. Thoda geela hai, dhoop mein sukha lena.

name: Umbrella (12 Holes Edition)
description: Better airflow ke liye 12 designer holes. Baarish mein extra refreshing experience.

name: Calculator (Always Says 5)
description: 2+2? 5. 10x10? 5. Tax calculation? 5. Simplicity at its finest.

name: Mobile Charger (0% Guarantee)
description: Charge hone ki koi guarantee nahi. Par plug toh lagta hai, woh bhi kuch hai.

name: Pen (No Ink Edition)
description: Imaginary writing ke liye perfect. Invisible ink nahi — ink hi nahi hai.

name: Magic Mirror
description: Aapka better-looking version dikhata hai. (Spoiler: woh Shah Rukh Khan ki photo hai)

name: Alarm Clock (5 Min Late Edition)
description: Bajta hai, par sirf aapke uthne ke 5 minute baad. Perfect for 'main toh utha tha' excuse.

name: Water Bottle (Empty, Pre-Owned)
description: Paani alag se dalna padega. Bottle mein pehle se ek fly ki yaadein hain.

name: T-Shirt (Size: Thoda Bada Thoda Chhota)
description: Na S, na M, na L. Ek naya size jo kisi ko fit nahi hota. Universal misfit.
